hooks.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 python "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/claims.py" status || echo '⚠ claims status failed: the edit-blocking hook may be broken too. Needs uv on PATH (Python 3.12). Tell the human.'

uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 python "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/claims.py" hook; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ $rc -ne 2 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: claims hook could not run (exit $rc; needs uv on PATH + Python 3.12). Failing closed. Tell the human; don't work around it." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit $rc
